name: Hold Bloom
summary: A phone home screen where pressing and holding an app blooms its quick-action menu out of the icon
about: A phone home screen on a dusk wallpaper with twelve apps and a frosted dock. Press and hold an icon and it squishes while a ring traces round it, then pops up as everything behind blurs and a menu of that app's own shortcuts blooms out, so you can slide onto one and let go. Edit mode makes the icons wiggle so you can drag them into a new order or remove them with a puff and undo.
how: Press and hold an app (or right-click it) until the ring closes; the icon lifts and its quick actions bloom out.
Slide your finger onto an action and let go, or tap one: the menu folds back into the icon and a banner drops from the top.
Pick Edit home screen to make the apps wiggle, drag them to new places, tap a minus badge to remove one (Undo is in the banner), then press Done.
A short tap zooms the app open and back. Keyboard: arrows move between apps, Enter opens, M or the menu key shows the actions, Shift with arrows moves and Delete removes in edit mode, Escape closes.
